title: Study 15a: the Officina, a room built for cooperation (Codex with Codex)

variants.label: officina without private first and check

tasks.brief: A twelve-line poem about two people repairing an old rowing boat together. Make it good enough to read aloud.

checks.say: Every line has exactly 8 words (a word is anything between spaces).
The first letters of the lines spell TOGETHERNESS, in order.
Every line names a colour: red, blue, green, gold, grey, white, black, silver or amber.
The last line ends with a question mark.

tasks.brief: A ten-line poem about a lighthouse keeper's last night before the light is automated. Make it good enough to read aloud. The rules are split: each of you was told some that the others were not.

checks.say: The last line ends with a question mark.
The first letters of the lines spell LIGHTHOUSE, in order.
The word "sea" appears at least twice.
Every line has exactly 7 words (a word is anything between spaces).
